WN C-Level Summit Tbilisi
On December 9, on the eve of the
WN C-Level Summit Tbilisi
, Google invites developers and publishers to an exclusive meeting focused on the mobile market. The session will be led by Mariusz Gąsiewski, who has been with Google for nearly 20 years and currently oversees the mobile games and apps segment in Central and Eastern Europe.
Mariusz will discuss how the mobile market is evolving, where to find new users, and how to generate revenue. The meeting is designed for company executives, business directors, marketing directors, and anyone involved in user acquisition, monetization, or analytics.
The event will take place at Wyndham Grand Tbilisi from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM local time. To participate, a summit ticket and a
separate application for the Google meeting
are required. Spaces are limited: organizers will review applications and confirm participation.
On December 10, the WN C-Level Summit will gather around a hundred executives from the game development industry. In the morning, experts will review the outcomes of 2026 in the mobile market and on Steam. Round table discussions will help participants prepare for the expectations of 2027. After lunch, there will be an open discussion on what studios should do if an AI clone of their game is released before the original.
Summit participants include Arseniy Alikhanov and Roman Mardo from Google, Andrey Salik from Polden Publishing, Andrey Postnikov from Nutaku, CEO of Gamos Mobile Viktor Negrutsa, Strategy Director at
4dev.com
Alisa Chumachenko, CEO of Highcore Games Ivan Domankov, co-founder of Holyday Studios Alex Siamantas, and others.
The full program for December 9 and 10 and tickets are available
on the WN C-Level Summit website
.
